text:
Elena (Payments): Heads up — Neurolytics SARL invoiced us for consulting (INV-2026-07) and AP accidentally withheld 30% on the wire because the tax doc looked odd. Can finance confirm if withholding was required?
VendorOps Bot: Vendor record: Neurolytics SARL, country=FR, VAT=FR12345678901, bank=BNP Paribas FR, payment currency=EUR, tax docs uploaded: w8ben_neuro_2026-05-02.pdf. Invoice INV-2026-07: net EUR 12,000; tax withheld = EUR 3,600.
Elena (Payments): They attached a file named w8ben_neuro_2026-05-02.pdf but the vendor is a French corporation (SARL). That seems wrong (W-8BEN is for individuals).
Aisha (Finance): Correct, W-8BEN is individual. Entities need W-8BEN-E. For a non-US entity providing services outside the US, generally no US withholding if foreign-source, but payer needs valid W-8BEN-E to document status. Because we only had an incorrectly completed W-8BEN, AP defaulted to withholding.
Sébastien (Neurolytics AP): Sorry — we sent the individual form by mistake. We can upload a signed W-8BEN-E immediately. Can Redwood refund the withheld amount or will they gross-up?
Ilya (Tax): Process: 1) Ask vendor to upload corrected, signed W-8BEN-E (entity form) and confirm the place of performance of services. 2) If the W-8BEN-E substantiates foreign status effective before payment date, we can potentially refund/net the withholding via a credit memo or reimbursement, but we must coordinate with US tax advisor — timing matters. 3) Gross-up: finance policy is generally not to gross-up withholding unless contractually agreed or exec approved.
Aisha (Finance): Agreed. We'll request: (a) a properly completed W-8BEN-E signed & dated; (b) a short statement confirming services were performed from France (or other non-US location) and the effective date; (c) whether they want a refund (wire) or a credit to next invoice. Use template below.
Elena (Payments): Sent vendor the template.
Aisha (Finance): Template to vendor (paste into outbound):
```
Hi Sébastien,

Thanks for the invoice and for sending the form. To process a refund of the EUR 3,600 withholding (or to issue a credit memo), please provide the following: 
1) A signed W-8BEN-E (entity) completed for Neurolytics SARL (not a W-8BEN individual form).
2) A short statement confirming the location where the services for INV-2026-07 were performed (e.g., "All consulting services were performed in France by Neurolytics SARL employees").
3) Confirmation of whether you prefer: (a) a credit memo applied to your next statement, or (b) a refund wire once we confirm the W-8BEN-E and consult with our tax advisor.

Please note: If we do not receive a valid W-8BEN-E that covers the payment date, U.S. withholding rules may require us to retain the withheld amount. We generally do not gross-up withholding amounts unless specified in the contract or approved by Finance + Legal.

Thanks,
Aisha \u2014 Redwood Finance
```
VendorOps Bot: Neurolytics uploaded w8bene_neuro_2026-05-03.pdf (pending review).
Ilya (Tax): I'll review the W-8BEN-E. If it properly documents foreign status and is effective prior to payment date, tax may allow refund of withholding to vendor (we'll need to request a refund from Treasury or issue vendor credit depending on circumstances). Coordinate with payroll/AP for mechanics.
Sébastien (Neurolytics AP): Uploaded W-8BEN-E and confirms services were performed in France. They prefer a credit memo applied to next invoice.
Aisha (Finance): Good. We'll accept credit memo route. Lina (AP) — please prepare CM-2026-12 to credit EUR 3,600 against Neurolytics' ledger and mark tax code FR-W8BEN-E-VALID. Also update vendor master with doc metadata (w8bene_neuro_2026-05-03.pdf signed_date=2026-05-03).
Elena (Payments): Will hold the withheld funds pending CM posting.
EngBillingBot: Ticket BILL-1299 created to add vendor tax status flag; assignee = Lina Z; due = 2026-05-10.
Aisha (Finance): I'll note this as a vendor tax exception (wrong form submitted -> corrected). We should add a short FAQ to vendor onboarding: "Use W-8BEN-E for entities; W-8BEN only for individuals; failure to provide correct form may trigger backup withholding."
Ilya (Tax): Agree. Also check contract language re: who bears tax liabilities going forward. If vendor wants to avoid recurrence, advise them to include valid W-8BEN-E before first invoice.
Sébastien (Neurolytics AP): Thanks, we'll update internal AP process. Appreciated.
Elena (Payments): Closing when credit memo posts and vendor confirms application. :white_check_mark:
